_about: Published RODNet schedule, transcribed from the reference implementation yizhou-wang/RODNet (configs/config_rodnet_*.py); the papers themselves state no schedule. Kept SEPARATE from RODNet_train_config.json so the repo default is untouched -- this file is for Phase 2 baseline-comparison runs, where the point is to reproduce the published AP/AR rather than to use the app's defaults. Differences from the repo default: lr 1e-5 (not 1e-4, which is 10x too high -- the same defect found in the DAROD and RAMP_CNN configs), StepLR(step_size=5, gamma=0.1) (not (10, 0.9); tools/train.py:174 hardcodes gamma 0.1), and real epoch counts (not the debug value 1). win_size/train_step/train_stride/test_step/test_stride already matched the reference (16/1/4/1/8) and are carried over unchanged. Note the reference's anneal is aggressive: lr drops 10x every 5 epochs, so training is essentially converged within ~20 epochs and the remaining epochs run at negligible lr.
_baseline_note: The published AP/AR figures are quoted '+ CRF'. CRF here is the cross-modal (camera-radar fusion) LABEL generation of the RODNet pipeline, not an evaluation or post-processing step. It constrains which annotations the model trains against -- the released CRUW dataset ships those labels -- rather than requiring anything extra at eval time.
